items.title: Managing Amazon Bedrock costs end to end: A playbook for FinOps and platform teams
items.excerpt: This post presents a five-stage operating model for managing Amazon Bedrock cost: attribute every dollar to an owner, make every request observable, enforce budgets, optimize platform defaults, and operate a review cadence. Written for FinOps and platform engineering teams.

items.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
items.excerpt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Session endpoints give each runtime session an authenticated URL that forwards any HTTP method, path, and WebSocket connection to the ports you allow. In this post, you deploy a coding agent that keeps a Vite website running in its session, then watch the live site update in your browser as the agent edits files.

items.title: nemotron-halloween
How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
items.excerpt: Worldwide Express automated its less-than-truckload freight billing-exception process with a multi-agent solution built on Amazon Bedrock. Six months after launch, the company cut active exceptions by 75%, improved time-to-cash by four weeks, and unlocked $10 million in free cash flow.

items.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
items.excerpt: The ChatGPT desktop app is now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US). This post walks through a controlled local deployment that routes model inference to Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-West) using API-mode sign-in, a managed device policy, a named AWS profile, and network restrictions, so a security team can validate it before broader use.
